sense.text:
“The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord.” The king’s heart is also the president’s heart, the president’s mind, because the heart is the mind, and it is in the hand of the Lord. “As the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” God turns the president’s heart, the king’s heart, wherever he will: whatever God wants that president or that king to do, he is going to do it.

So in Trump doing what he is doing right now, the Most High God is the one putting it in his heart. He is taking away birthright citizenship and a lot of the benefits that negroes get here in America. There is a rise of the Patriot Front, the KKK and all these things in America. God is behind all of that, and there is a reason for it: this is the beginning stages of affliction, and Trump 2.0 is the new and improved Trump who came back with a vengeance.

precepts.why:
“This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men.” God rules in the kingdom of men. It is done on a spiritual plane that we can’t see and can’t understand, but the ones pulling the strings are the Most High God and the angels.

“And giveth it to whomsoever he will.” He gave the rulership of America and this earth to Trump. He helped him to be president. So yes, God set up Trump to be president. The same way God gave Nebuchadnezzar the rulership of the world in his time, then gave it to Cyrus, then gave it to Rome, God sets up these nations to rule over us.

And what did Nebuchadnezzar do to the Israelites? He came against Judah, enslaved us and took us into Babylon as slaves. God set him up to rule, and God used him, the wicked of the earth that he set up, to judge his people. The same way God set up Nebuchadnezzar, he set up Trump, and he set him up for a reason.

“Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword.” The wicked is God’s sword. God uses the wicked as his sword to punish his people.

For the last decades the negroes here in America and the Hispanics throughout the islands and all over the world have forgotten who the wicked is: the sword that was used to enslave them, destroy them and take them as slaves. That is why God turned the king’s heart the way he did.

“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked.” Who is ruling the earth today? America and Europe, the superpowers on the earth. They are the wicked that the earth is given into the hands of.

“He covereth the faces of the judges thereof.” The judges are the 12 tribes of Israel. We are the judges of the earth, the ones who are supposed to be judging and ruling the earth in righteousness, but our faces have been covered: nobody knows that we are the real judges, because we are enslaved and destroyed and the wicked is ruling and judging the earth instead.

But our people have forgotten who the wicked is. The Hispanic tribes, the northern kingdom, have forgotten the people that came over and conquered and destroyed them; the Mexicans forgot. So God brought Trump into power to give our people a rude awakening, because you think America is all inclusion and you think white people and Europeans love you.

Look at the migrants being put on a deportation flight on national television with chains around their feet and their hands. These brothers and sisters came here for a better opportunity and a better way of life, because their countries are destroyed. They put it on television to put fear in any other migrant who wants to cross the border, and because they are the wicked. Isn’t that the same way they had us enslaved? They shackled our hands and our feet and brought us over here on cargo slave ships. It is the same thing. That is why the president of Colombia said he would send his own plane and bring his people back in dignity, not shackled and chained up, children included, on military planes.

sense.text:
“The gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies.” The gates of the land are America’s. These last couple of years, under the Biden administration, the borders were set wide open.

But who are the enemies? All you have been seeing these last weeks are videos of ICE raiding houses and businesses, separating mothers and fathers from their children, and deporting brothers and sisters from Haiti, Guatemala and Venezuela, who came here seeking a better life and a good job. Those are not the enemies. The enemies it is talking about are the Chinese, the Pakistanis, the Afghans and the Iranians. Thousands of America’s enemies came through that border and are hiding in America right now, yet there is not one video of Arabs, Afghans or Chinese being deported.

All of a sudden the news networks and social media that hated Trump are all pro Trump and showing nothing but this. It is fear mongering. Brothers and sisters, do not be sitting in the house afraid; that is what they are putting these things out there for.
“The hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve” is the slavery we were made to serve.

“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon.” The king of Babylon here is America. “And say, How hath the oppressor ceased!” You are all going to find out who the oppressor is. The oppressor has been hiding for the last decades, ever since the 60s, and our people went back to sleep. He was oppressing secretly, behind the curtain, but now he is rising back up and is going to oppress openly.

“The golden city ceased!” The oppressor is also called the golden city, and the golden city is America, because America is the richest country on this earth. That is why brothers come from all over the world to America, seeking opportunity and a better life: for the American dream. But the American dream is just what it says, a dream. The only way you can enjoy it is to be asleep, blind to racism and the oppression of your people, and we are awake. The American dream is really a nightmare. Coming here at sixteen to Brooklyn, the second day there was a brother on the street with a bullet in his head, and the first time racism was ever experienced was here, from a white police officer. Everything they show on TV and in Hollywood is a dream.

The richest country on the earth is also called the oppressor. So the Most High put Trump in office to turn up oppression on our people, because our people come to America seeking the American dream and forgot that this place is the oppressor. They forgot that the so-called white man murders and kills; that is how he got this land.

“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.” The rulers of this golden city are called the wicked. After the civil rights movement, when they gave us a few rights, our people forgot who the wicked is and who the oppressor is, and the Lord put Trump in office to remind you.

So don’t be mad that you see Trump in office. God put him there, and God saved him from being assassinated, because the Most High wants you, brothers and sisters, to look and see. Don’t you feel some way about what you see him doing, and about the things coming out of the mouths of the people supporting him? This is how they really feel and how they look at you, black people and Hispanics.

precepts.why: Why is everybody coming to America? Because this place is called the golden city; this place is rich. “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen.” Babylon the great is America. When John the Revelator wrote this, he saw a future prophecy of America destroyed: America is fallen, already fallen, “and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.”

“For in one hour so great riches is come to nought.” Within one hour the whole of America will be destroyed, in the third world war.

“So great riches”: that is why everybody comes here to America, because of the riches. America is the richest country on the earth, the golden city, and in one hour those riches come to nought.

“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city.” Which is the greatest city, the greatest country on the planet earth? America: the richest, the most powerful militarily and economically. That is why everybody wants to come here seeking the American dream.

But the American dream is over. That time has passed. The 80s, the 90s, the early 2000s, when you could come here, work, build a house and live comfortably, are done. White people are saying, I don’t want to be equal to negroes and Arabs and Chinese. That time is done.

sense.text:
“The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death.” What we are seeing happen now is the beginning. Right now there is famine in Ukraine and in Africa, though you in America don’t really know what is going on all over the earth, because the American media shields you from it.

“The beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear.” The Russia and Ukraine war, the Palestinian and Israel war: we are in the beginning stages of these things. These last four years were wars after wars popping off, and it is not going to stop. “The beginning of evils! what shall I do when these evils shall come?”

“Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.” Tribulation, plague, famine: all these things are sent for amendment, and amendment means judgment. The Most High is sending these plagues to bring judgment on the earth.

Trump said that if he had been in office none of it would have happened: Russia would never have invaded Ukraine and the Palestinian war would never have happened. He can’t stop anything from happening. He is not going to prevent World War III, or the wars, the pestilence, the famine and the plagues that are coming forth on this earth. Matter of fact, he is going to propel it. God is sending them to bring judgment on the nations.

“But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness, nor be alway mindful of the scourges.” The nations are not going to repent or stop the wickedness they are doing on the earth.

The coronavirus was a scourge. It hit in 2020, and millions of people died. Does anybody talk about the coronavirus anymore, or the people who lost loved ones? Were the people mindful of God’s scourges, and did they repent of the evil they have been doing on the earth? No.

“Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth.” Victuals are goods and food. Where are victuals cheap? Not in Africa, Venezuela, Jamaica or Trinidad. It is talking about here in America, because America is a rich country; the food here is cheap, and a lot of the time the government gives it out free.

“That they shall think themselves to be in good case.” That is you thinking everything is good because food and things are cheap: you have the house, the car, a job and a good life. That is the state of mind of a lot of brothers and sisters who come from the islands, from Venezuela, Guatemala, Mexico and Jamaica: things are cheap here, so you get comfortable and you love this place.

So God says, my people are getting too comfortable in Babylon. I am going to send Trump into office, have racist people surround him, and make him dismantle everything that makes my people comfortable in Babylon. That is what you are seeing take place. “And even then shall evils grow upon earth”: when you think you are good, evil is going to keep multiplying upon the earth. That is why the top verse says it is the beginning of sorrows.

precepts.why:
“These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself.” The white man thinks God is like him: that God is evil and God is white and looks like him.

“But I will reprove thee”: that is the amendment. How is God going to reprove them? He is going to send famine, plagues, wars and destruction to America and all the nations. God says, I will judge you.

“And set them in order before thine eyes.” He will set the 12 tribes of Israel in order right before their eyes. You are going to be watching them grow and turn into a nation right before your eyes, and while he is raising them up, he is bringing plagues on you.

sense.text:
“Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest.” A lot of our people think America is the land of milk and honey. But what does the Bible call America? The oppressor, the wicked. Yet our people think this place is their rest.

It is not our rest. We were not brought here to be comfortable and live the American dream. We were brought here as slaves, for punishment for our sins.

“Because it is polluted, it shall destroy you.” Everywhere you look is filth and wickedness. If you make this place your rest and sit down chasing the American dream, it is going to destroy you. People were crying in tears and losing their minds because they were being sent back to their countries, because Europe and America have deceived the world into thinking their countries are the best places on the earth, because of the riches.

“Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me.” The rebellious children are the 12 tribes of Israel, taking counsel, but not from God.

“That cover with a covering, but not of my spirit.” The covering we cover ourselves with is Christianity and the politics here in America. We don’t cover ourselves with the covering of God, which is the scriptures; we cover ourselves in false religions.

“That they may add sin to sin.” That shows it is a false religion. Christianity says you don’t have to keep God’s laws anymore, that they are done away with, and they set up a white image of Christ, when Christ was a black man from the tribe of Judah. So you add sin to sin in these false coverings.

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!” This literally took place: we went down to ancient Egypt for help and trusted in it. But it says the shadow of Egypt, so it is not the real Egypt we are trusting in but its shadow. It is twofold: our people trusted in America, because America is the new Egypt.

“Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame.” The strength you look for in the president is going to be a shame. You trusted in America, and it will be a shame for all of you who went to vote and supported Trump, or Biden, or Kamala. You are going to realize these people can’t save you.

“And the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.” The trust in America, the shadow of Egypt, is going to be your confusion.

precepts.why: “And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt.” The great city, America, is spiritually called Egypt. That is why the shadow of Egypt our people trust in is America, the new Egypt, and the strength of Pharaoh they lean on is the strength of America’s president.

sense.text: “For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie.” At the end the vision is going to speak, and it is speaking to us right now, in these last days. “Though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come.”
“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him.” Whose soul is it talking about? The Europeans, the so-called white men. Their soul is not right in them.

“He is a proud man”: it is talking about the white man. “Neither keepeth at home”: he is in everybody’s country, destabilizing every country. That is why people from all over the world come to America: because America doesn’t stay at home.

“Who enlargeth his desire as hell.” The desire he has for the things he wants from other countries, whether it is oil, gold or whatever resource, he enlarges like hell. Now America is talking about taking Greenland and the Panama Canal, and they will do it; Denmark is already talking about stepping up its military because of what Trump said. “And is as death”: wherever the so-called American goes, he brings death with him, Iraq, Afghanistan. “And cannot be satisfied” with what he has.

“But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people.” America did not become rich because it has a lot of gold. America became rich by robbing and stealing from nations. After the war they set up the IMF and they control the world economy: if you don’t agree with them, they sanction you and say you can’t use their dollar, and all nations use the American dollar to trade. The dollar is not backed by any gold standard; it is fiat money, and America is rich because it can create money out of nothing, trillions, printed digitally and wired out. Now Russia, China and Brazil have formed BRICS to separate from the IMF and the sanctions America and Europe put on third world countries.

Who heaps unto himself all people? Not Iran: America, the great melting pot. Remember Venezuela. Venezuela was a rich country that used to offer free heating oil to people in New York. America put sanctions on it and seized its gold overseas, in London; Chavez cursed out Bush, and the economic hit men destabilized Venezuela’s economy. Now thousands of Venezuelans are coming to America seeking a better life, because their economy was destroyed by America. America causes the problem, and when the people come here it says, go back to your country. If you want the people to stay in their countries, stop the economic hit men and the sanctions and leave them alone to develop. But God wants it to happen.

“And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.” At one point in time everybody spoke one language. This is the start of ancient Babylon, and it shows the mindset they had back then, which is the same mindset here in America today.

“Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven.” That is like the skyscrapers you see here in America; they wanted to do the same thing in ancient Babylon. “And let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth”: let all of us have a name for ourselves.

“And the Lord said, Behold, the people is one.” That state of mind, where all nations come together and say they are one people, is the state of mind of ancient Babylon, and America has that same state of mind. America heaps unto itself all people, and that makes America mystery Babylon.

precepts.why:
“And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men.” They are the Caucasian race, the Edomites. This is the last kingdom ruling upon the earth, the European nations and mainly America. In the last of this kingdom everybody comes together in America and says they are one people.

“But they shall not cleave one to another.” There will be division in America and Europe. Even though they heap unto themselves all nations and say we are all one people, racist white people are always going to rise up and say they can’t stand Chinese. “Even as iron is not mixed with clay”: you can’t mix white people with the other nations, because white people don’t want to mix with them. That is what we are seeing, and now they are saying it out loud.

That is what Make America great again means: the rise of white supremacy. America was created by Europeans for Europeans, and talk not heard since the 30s and the 50s is back. The Patriot Front is the new KKK, and they march with masks on their faces because many of them are judges, lawyers, police officers, school teachers and politicians, people you meet every day who don’t want to lose their jobs. They want the man who had his foot on George Floyd’s neck set free, and most likely he will be. One of the officials put over national security has an Aryan Nation tattoo on his chest. A white woman said she finds it hilarious that families are being separated and called them subhumans. God is turning up affliction on our people.

That is what you negroes need, so you can wake up. Especially you Puerto Ricans, Dominicans and Mexicans: a lot of you think you are white because you have some white blood, because the white man raped your forefathers, and some of you have light skin and long hair. You are children of the slave trade, of captivity, just like us, and this is your wake-up call.

“And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” America is called mystery Babylon the great because, the same way ancient Babylon got all people to come together and say let us all be one people, America has done the same today.

For America to transform herself into mystery Babylon the great, birthright citizenship had to take place. When it was set up, the Lord was behind the leaders to leave it unclear, so that in the future everybody could use it and all people could come here and become one citizen once they were born here.

The 14th Amendment, among the Reconstruction amendments right after the Civil War and emancipation, was for Judah: the slaves who were brought here on ships. It made them citizens, though they were never truly given their rights; they set up prisons and brought them right back to slavery, and they could not vote until the Voting Rights of the 60s. To prove it was only for the slaves, the Constitution excluded the Indians, who only became citizens in 1924. The Chinese, the Arabs, the West Indians, the Jamaicans and the Trinidadians don’t fall under it either. It was for Judah, but the Most High set it up so that everybody benefited from it. The same with the civil rights Judah fought for in the 60s: they were hijacked, and the Chinese, the homosexuals, the Jewish people, everybody benefited from them except the people who fought for them. Being able to come to America, have kids here and have those kids be citizens is all because of Judah, who has been caught in hell for centuries, and everybody has forgotten it. All you tribes had better start giving Judah the props.

Now Trump is about to change birthright citizenship, and most likely he will, because he controls the Senate, the House and the judges. But it is too late: America has already been established as mystery Babylon the great, and all nations are already here.

sense.text:
America becoming great again means affliction for our people. “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” The throne of iniquity is America, and the mischief framed by law is the executive orders Trump is passing.

There was the DEI order. DEI, diversity, equity and inclusion, was supposed to be set up to include the blacks, but it mainly benefited white women and homosexuals; the last people it really benefited were black people. Everybody has benefited from these rights in America except the people they were created for. Now there will most likely be no more Black History Month, the Martin Luther King holiday will be done away with, and a documentary on the Tuskegee experiment was taken down. All those programs that made black people feel some type of welcome in American society are going to be taken away from the negroes. And that is a good thing: black people need to wake up from this dream. And now our Mexican sisters understand that Trump doesn’t like them, the same way he doesn’t like black people. The Most High is a mastermind.

Biden knew what he was doing when he opened the border: he was creating chaos. Order through chaos: the Democrats create the chaos, then the Republicans come and set up laws. That is how they create laws. Tell people it is okay to shoplift under $800 and they won’t go to jail, and then Trump comes in and says anyone who shoplifts is going to be shot.

The mischief behind these executive orders: birthright citizenship is being taken away, and it will most likely stand in the courts, because it was really for the black slaves and not for everybody. People are trying to induce labor so their babies are born before it is enforced, but a lot of you who were born here to parents who were not are going to have that taken away. An order to protect the United States from aliens who espouse hateful ideology is about what you teach; they already put us as the number two most hateful group in America and say the teaching is racist. An order to crack down on anti-Semitism and deport foreign students is really geared towards us, because we say that the people in the land are not the Jews. So if you were not born here, if you have a green card or became a naturalized citizen and you teach this Bible, they will take your green card or your citizenship away and deport you. It is designed to stop us from teaching.

Should we stop teaching? No. We are not going to stop teaching what God says no matter what he does. If he deports you back to your country, teach. If he puts you in prison, teach. And what they mean for evil, God means for good: deport the teachers brought up under the Bishop and the Deacons, and the Lord sends them out to different countries to teach the truth to our people. You can’t stop this truth.

There is nothing new under the sun; the same thing that was done is the same thing that shall be done. “Because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome.” Trump said there will be mass deportation, and Claudius Caesar deported every last Jew living in Rome: all of you get out of my country, we don’t want you here. It is the same thing you are seeing today.

Notice it says Claudius deported all Jews and doesn’t say anything about the other nations living in Rome. The same Jews deported under ancient Rome are the same Jews being deported under America. The Lord is showing you who he is doing this to, his intended target.

precepts.why: Who were the Jews? “Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger.” Barnabas was a Jew, and Simeon was a Jew that was called Niger, and Niger means black. So the Jews deported from Rome were black. That is where the word comes from.

sense.text: “Let us oppress the poor righteous man, let us not spare the widow, nor reverence the ancient gray hairs of the aged.” That is what these laws are designed to do: to oppress the poor righteous man.

“Let our strength be the law of justice”: that is what they say, and those are the executive orders they sign. “For that which is feeble is found to be nothing worth.” They think we are worthless, as the white woman said when she called us subhumans.

“Therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous.” That is what they are going to do here in America: they are lying in wait for the righteous. “Because he is not for our turn”: we are not for your turn, your presidential term or any of that. “And he is clean contrary to our doings: he upbraideth us with our offending the law, and objecteth to our infamy the transgressings of our education.”
“He professeth to have the knowledge of God”: we have the knowledge of God. “And he calleth himself the child of the Lord”: we are the children of God.

“Who will rise up for me against the evildoers?” Brothers, the question is which one of you men is going to rise up against the evildoers, against the wicked? Would you stop teaching because Trump threatened to deport you, or to put you in jail?

“Or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?” That is our job, brothers: to stand up against the evildoers and the workers of iniquity, let them know they are wrong for what they are doing, and let them know that God is bringing judgment on them.

precepts.why:
This is what comes with standing up against the workers of iniquity. Laws are going to be set up; some of us are going to get deported and some of us are going to be put in prison. That is part of what we signed up for.

“And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.” When you teach the teachings of Christ, you are going to be hated, for Christ’s name’s sake. “But he that endureth to the end shall be saved.” Whatever you go through, you have to endure. Don’t be scared of any executive order telling you that you can’t teach the word of God. Are you going to run inside and hide, and stop teaching God’s word? No. The only way you are going to be saved is to keep enduring to the end.

sense.text:
There is a reason why the Most High brought Trump into power. “Regard not the wicked inventions of the heathen”: don’t regard the laws they create to bring affliction upon us.

“But the desire of those that keep thy testimonies in afflictions.” God wants us to keep his testimonies in affliction. Bad things are going to happen to us, and that is where God wants us to keep his testimonies. If Trump puts out an executive order saying we can’t teach the Bible the way we teach it anymore, affliction is going to come down on us, and what God is looking for is those who do what he said to do while they are being afflicted. This is war.

Some of you might say, I ain’t teaching the Bible no more, I don’t want them to take away my green card or my citizenship. If that is how you are thinking, this ain’t the place for you. Trump 2.0 is about to turn up affliction on the Israelites, but we have to keep the testimony in affliction. If he puts you in Guantanamo Bay, teach the word in Guantanamo Bay. If they deport you back to your country, teach the word over there.

precepts.why:
Why do we have to go through affliction, if God loves us? “Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.” The only way you are going to be chosen is to go through that affliction.

Some brothers and sisters think this is a Christian church, where you come and expect everything to be all lovey-dovey and your life to be perfect. It is not. The only way you gain the Kingdom of Heaven is by enduring affliction; you have to prove to God that you are worthy. You can run around scared like everybody else and say I am not teaching the Bible anymore, or you can do what God says no matter what affliction comes upon you. And he does it for his own sake.

sense.text: “Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.” In this affliction we must be strong in the Lord and in the power of his might.
“Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?” Why are the nations angry?

“The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed.” Against Christ, and against his anointed, and his anointed is us: we are his anointed ones.

“Let us break their bands asunder.” This is what America and Europe are going to try to do. The bands are our groups; they will try to break us up. “And cast away their cords from us.” The cords are the teachings of Christ. They are going to try to cast them away by instituting laws: if we teach this way, we go to jail, or lose our citizenship, or lose our green card.

“He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh.” God is going to laugh at them. This white man doesn’t understand the type of people God has sent on the earth. “The Lord shall have them in derision.”

So don’t be afraid of the things the US government sets up to bring affliction upon our people, brothers and sisters. It is all by design. God is trying you, and he is waking our people up too. It is being revealed to the northern kingdom brothers and sisters who the wicked is: they are starting to understand that these white people don’t like them, the same way they don’t like black people.

“Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it.” Brothers, neither Trump nor any government can overthrow the work we are doing on this earth. The gates of hell are not going to prevail against this truth. “Lest haply ye be found even to fight against God”: it is God they are fighting against.

“When they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus.” They beat the apostles and told them not to speak in Christ’s name: stop teaching what you are teaching.

Look at what the disciples did: “they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.” Brothers, when you go through things in this truth, affliction and all of that, it is because you are counted worthy. That is how you have to look at it.

“And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.” They went back daily and did not cease to teach. None of you brothers should talk about not teaching the gospel anymore because Trump might deport you or take away your green card or your citizenship. As men of God we are to fear no man. Our job is to wake our people up; let them do what they have to do. We are not going to stop teaching the gospel, and that is the state of mind we have to have.

“Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.” Brothers and sisters whose family members got caught up by immigration, stop worrying. Cast your cares upon God, because he cares for you, no matter what you are going through.

That is why he is allowing Trump to do this to our people: because our people are asleep. The Spanish tribes are asleep, but they are waking up now; because of what Trump is doing to them, all the Latinos are coming together for a summit. So what are you Judahites in America going to do? Run scared and hide?

True leaders are only known in affliction. When the people are being afflicted, that is when the leaders God set on the earth are going to rise. Which one of you brothers is going to rise up against the workers of iniquity and do what God tells you to do in affliction?

“And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.” Don’t be afraid of the KKK, of any racist group, of MAGA; don’t be afraid of anybody, brothers. They can kill your body and imprison you, and after that there is no more that they can do. “But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell.”

“Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God? But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore.” Every hair on your head is numbered. You can’t lose one hair without the Lord saying so. So don’t fear them.

“Who comforteth us in all our tribulation.” We are going to go through tribulations, brothers, but the Lord is going to comfort us in all our tribulation, “that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.”

“For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.” Brothers and sisters, we must suffer in this truth; we must go through affliction. The only way we are going to get that prize is by going through affliction and suffering, enduring in affliction, keeping the word in affliction and not giving up.

“And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring.” The enduring is the key thing: you must endure. So if Trump says he is going to deport you for teaching, don’t stop teaching. Wherever you get deported to, go and teach the gospel.

As men of God we should not be living in fear. Fear no man and fear no executive order. The only one we should fear is our God.
